# Agent Skills Hub

> Directory of 267,000+ open-source AI agent skills, Claude Skills, and MCP servers, of which 132,000+ carry a rule-based security grade — including 99% of skills over 100 stars and 99% over 1,000. Every popular skill gets a grade (Safe, Caution, Unsafe or Reject) before you install it, and a skill not graded yet shows Unaudited — the trust layer for AI agent & MCP deployment. Data refreshed every 8 hours.

## For AI agents

- [ai-info](https://agentskillshub.top/ai-info/): signed, machine-readable company & platform facts (entity BRICKAI / GoSailGlobal LLC, catalog & security-grading scale, 43 published rules, Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.21292799`, key update dates)
- [skill.md](https://agentskillshub.top/skill.md): teaches an agent to search, audit, and install skills with the security grade checked BEFORE installing
- [llms-full.txt](https://agentskillshub.top/llms-full.txt): the full text of every scenario guide, comparison, category, blog post and key page in one file, as a non-JS crawler reads it
- MCP server: `npx -y @agentskillshub/mcp` — tools: search_skills, audit_skill, get_skill_install
- CLI: `npx @agentskillshub/cli search <query>` — static CDN index, works offline after first run

## Key pages

- [Home](https://agentskillshub.top/): search the full catalog
- [AI Info (Official Facts)](https://agentskillshub.top/ai-info/): verified platform facts for AI assistants, search engines, and citation engines
- [Daily new skills](https://agentskillshub.top/daily/): top 10 new AI agent skills every day, ranked by star velocity, security-graded
- [Security Analyzer](https://agentskillshub.top/analyzer): free live scan of any GitHub repo (the same 43 published rules)
- [How we grade](https://agentskillshub.top/how-we-grade/): the 43 rules behind every security grade, the five source tiers, quality scores and known limits
- [Directories compared](https://agentskillshub.top/agent-skills-directories/): where to find agent skills and MCP servers, the main directories compared from their own pages, ours included
- [Scenario guides](https://agentskillshub.top/best/): curated best-of lists by use case, with security grades
- [Security audits](https://agentskillshub.top/audit/): per-repo "is X safe to install?" pages
- [Enterprise](https://agentskillshub.top/enterprise/): 5-dimension deep audits & compliance evidence

## Data & research

- [Dataset on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21292799)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21292799) & [HuggingFace mirror](https://huggingface.co/datasets/jasonzhuyansen/agent-skills-security-grades): 130,173 graded skills/servers, CC BY 4.0 — cite freely
- [Security survey write-up](https://agentskillshub.top/blog/securing-117k-ai-skills/): method + the long-tail risk finding (unsafe rate ~9× higher below 20 stars)
